focus.name: player-apple-count
focus.purpose: Confirm the gameplay projection of the shared ASCII counter from the player apple action and HUD path.

rom_evidence.name: PLAYER_ANIM_THROW_APPLE
rom_evidence.effect: Its data-driven AnimationVM path pushes InteractionCounter_DecrementPrimaryDigits at 0x00122450 before returning to the player animation selector.

rom_evidence.name: Render_BuildActorRecords
rom_evidence.effect: It emits the two ASCII digits at 0x00FFEFE0 as HUD actor records when the word is nonzero.

qualification: The alias identifies the player-facing resource represented by this word. Shared interaction/resource callers remain valid and are not reclassified as separate storage.
conclusion: The FFEFE0 word is the player apple count in the recorded gameplay path: it begins at ASCII 10, the A/apple action enters the apple animation path, and the counter becomes ASCII 09 after the callback. The neutral INTERACTION_COUNTER_DIGITS name is retained as the canonical address-level name, with PLAYER_APPLE_COUNT_DIGITS exposed as its semantic alias.
